name: star-wide
comment: Every PROGRADE face a uniform polyhedron uses, at D=120: {3,4,5,6,8,10} and the star faces {5/2}, {8/3}, {10/3}. Planar interior angles 60, 90, 108, 120, 135, 144, 36, 45, 72 all land on the 3-degree grid. What is NOT here is the RETROGRADE family {5/3}, {5/4}, {10/7}, {3/2}, whose interior angle (n-2d)*pi/n is negative: a retrograde face subtracts from the vertex angle sum, and enum_configs recurses on a monotonically increasing total, so negative corner units break the prune, not just the palette. That is the third category and it is a search change, not an alphabet row.
